Hello あらら Sensei! I absolutely love your art style—it's so cute! I'd like to request a drawing of my OC. The scene I envision involves my OC wearing a diving suit and forging iron in the deep sea. While it might seem illogical—after all, how can one forge iron underwater?—but I'm really keen on seeing this scenario! Imagine the deep sea setting, with the young girl working on glowing red-hot iron, surrounded by fish.
Thank you !

Hello,
I would like you to draw my shark girl.
https://imgur.com/a/Q1EMZZn

She is a cheerful tomboy that wears a fishing lure for an earring and has a mole on her left cheek. In this image, I would like you to remove the fishing lure from her ear. This image will be a story of how she obtained it. It's intended to be humorous.

I would like a close up image of her underwater having just bitten the lure. It should have the full set of hooks attached like this image: 
https://i.imgur.com/85HZQbI.png

Additionally, please add gills to her neck as in this image where visible: 
https://i.imgur.com/fHx9hPz.png

The hook is not piercing her cheek or cause any harm, but it should stretch her mouth as it pulls, like this:
 https://i.imgur.com/KeRLlcp.jpeg

She should have an expression of confusion and surprise as if she has not yet figured out what is happening.

Thank you,

Sensei! 

I've been an avid follower for some time now and I really enjoy all of your hero works. I wanted to ask if you like cowboys! My request is my persona who is sort of a traditional western meets fantasy outlaw. Important to note is the literal use of the term "cow-boy" as there are horns under the hat. His personality is fiery and rather charming but only to those who can get through his outer shell. The buttons on the vest are repurposed alligator teeth. The weapon (a modified, 7 shot, Mateba Model 6 Unica that has rounds chambered for each of the 7 Deadly Sins) is totally optional and can be drawn holstered or placed strategically out of frame for the purposes of an illustration.

Aside from this I would like to leave everything as open-ended for your personal touches as much as possible! I'd love to see what you'd add to the character beit posing, expression(s), and otherwise

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dWkDdcPMW3X7wVQcG1xqnvZputaBswPg?usp=sharing

A few more requests if it's ok!

Could you please draw my OC Klubkub?
https://imgur.com/a/BU9BYpD
A crab man.
He's the strongest creature living in an ancient forest full of giant monsters bigger than him.
He's the apex predator in the forest. Able to instantly defeat his prey with a single punch. (Imagine something close to Juggernaut and Hulk)
height 200cm

On his back is his friend Clewlyo. A jellyfish who helped him since he was young. They have a good relationship and help each.
Clewlyo can absorb poisons and help Klubkub escape danger most of the time.

Klubkub is a very curious creature and usually is interested in interaction with all creatures, but he's so strong everything in the forest runs away from him.

He became a friend of Belinda (my red haired OC) after her fought her thinking she came to invade his home.
He becomes very attached to her and usually hugs her very hard (Belinda can handle it, she's super strong too...)

I leave the illustration choice to you. Have fun!

It's been a while, thank you for opening again!

Murasaki and Janaki are slightly drunk in the celebration and have larger grins on their face with a light blush While Velka has her glass raised and winks. Both Janaki and Murasaki have dress references but feel free to use some sort of cocktail dress design for them!
